description: We are the space medic engineer. We are interested in maintaining the constant visualization on the health of each astronauts in space. All of us are computer science students, with concentrations varying from cyber security to data science. U should join us if u want to be a part of a relaxed team. Our goal is to do our best at completing our project while having fun and NOT to beat others. This doesn't mean that we are not taking this seriously. We need someone with frontend skills.
